question: Does ordered adjacent batting-pair identity add out-of-sample predictive value to additive batter IDs?
population: retrospective KBO boxscore-derived lineup, 2025 training and 2026 evaluation; matched 2-way full-game historical price only as separate selection-biased diagnostic
split: 2025-03-22 through 2025-08-31 train, 2025-09-01 through 2025-12-31 validation; refit all 2025, 2026 evaluation frozen
models: team/opponent/home + additive nine batter identities vs same plus directed cyclic 9 adjacent batter pairs; ridge regression for team runs, independent Poisson score approximation; no market input
selection: additive and pair share fixed alpha=100; pair penalty chosen by validation run MSE over 10,100,1000; select higher penalty on tie; no evaluation tuning
inference: Poisson score grid 0..30, conditional non-draw home probability; draw refunds retained when prices exist; weekly cluster bootstrap 2000 repetitions seed 20261108; single unit; no real or wallet wagering
constraints: Postgame actual lineup oracle only; timestamps and historical price execution unverified; output is predictive association not causal contribution; no claim of operational M0 reproduction; OMP and BLAS threads one
